json_ld.description:
We've recreated the feeling of your favorite lived-in shirt with our new Vintage Wash styles. We started with a wahsed micro seersucker with a fine, rippled texture—then gave it a special treatment that breaks down fibers for a soft feel from the very first wear. This all-cotton shirt has a subtle plaid that looks solid from a distance—perfect for the weekend and warm-weather getaways alike.
A Stay-Put Collar, unbreakable buttons, and single-needle side seams give this shirt a refined feel that holds up wear after wear. Designed to move seamlessly from casual days to dressed-up moments, it pairs easily with our Stretch Chino Shorts for a relaxed, confident look that always feels put-together.
FEATURES
• Button-down collar • Tan signature sail • SKU #42281Tan
FABRICS
• 100% Cotton • Imported
